mapper.select: SELECT major_dentist_id AS majorDentistId, chief_complaint AS chiefComplaint, present_illness AS presentIllness, past_history AS pastHistory, examination, diagnosis, plan FROM medical_common_record WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medical_common_record ( id, treatment_id, patient_id, major_dentist_id, chief_complaint, present_illness, past_history, re_examination, examination, diagnosis, plan, treatment, prescription, type, status, approval_time, time, crt_id, crt_time, upd_id, upd_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{treatmentId}, #{patientId}, #{majorDentistId}, #{chiefComplaint}, #{presentIllness}, #{pastHistory}, #{reExamination}, #{examination}, #{diagnosis}, #{plan}, #{treatment}, #{prescription}, #{type}, #{status}, #{approvalTime}, #{time}, #{crtId}, #{crtTime}, #{updId}, #{updTime} )
